prompts.instruction: Make a dashboard called monthly-revenue that shows total revenue (amount) per month as a line chart.

checks.check_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS m, sum(amount) AS v FROM orders GROUP BY 1

prompts.instruction: Build a dashboard named region-revenue with a bar chart of total revenue by region.

checks.check_sql: SELECT region, sum(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

prompts.instruction: Create a dashboard called order-count with a single KPI showing the total number of orders.
Make a dashboard net-revenue with a KPI of total revenue excluding refunded orders, and a bar chart of that same net revenue by product category.

checks.check_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM orders WHERE NOT refunded
SELECT category, sum(amount) FROM orders WHERE NOT refunded GROUP BY 1

prompts.instruction: Dashboard top-products: a table of the 5 products with the most revenue, with product name and revenue.

checks.check_sql: SELECT product, sum(amount) AS r FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

prompts.instruction: Create a dashboard channel-mix showing the number of orders per month split by channel, as a stacked bar chart.

checks.check_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS m, channel, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1, 2

prompts.instruction: Make a dashboard sessions-by-source with total sessions per traffic source from the traffic data, as a bar chart.

checks.check_sql: SELECT source, sum(sessions) FROM traffic GROUP BY 1

prompts.instruction: Dashboard signup-rate: a bar chart of the signup rate (signups divided by sessions) for each traffic source.

checks.check_sql: SELECT source, sum(signups) / sum(sessions) FROM traffic GROUP BY 1

prompts.instruction: Make a dashboard regional with a select filter for region (options from the data) and a KPI of total revenue that respects the filter. With no region selected it should show the total for all regions.
Edit the existing dashboard named start: keep everything and add a bar chart of revenue by channel.

checks.check_sql: SELECT channel, sum(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

prompts.instruction: Edit the existing dashboard named start: change the monthly chart so it shows number of orders per month instead of revenue. Keep the other panel.

checks.check_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date), count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

prompts.instruction: Edit the existing dashboard named start: rename it to 'Company revenue' and make the monthly chart full width. Do not remove anything.

panels.title: Total revenue
panels.sql: SELECT sum(amount) AS revenue FROM orders

panels.title: Revenue by month
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, sum(amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
